+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""A small Python port of the eza behavior used by this benchmark."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import fnmatch
+import os
+import re
+import stat
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Iterable, Sequence
+
+
+VERSION_TEXT = "eza - A modern, maintained replacement for ls\nv0.23.3 [+git]\nhttps://github.com/eza-community/eza\n"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Options:
+    mode: str = "auto"
+    all_count: int = 0
+    almost_all: bool = False
+    dirs_as_files: bool = False
+    only_dirs: bool = False
+    only_files: bool = False
+    no_symlinks: bool = False
+    show_symlinks: bool = False
+    reverse: bool = False
+    sort: str = "name"
+    dirs_first: bool = False
+    dirs_last: bool = False
+    level: int | None = None
+    width: int = 80
+    classify: str = "never"
+    absolute: str = "off"
+    no_quotes: bool = False
+    long: bool = False
+    header: bool = False
+    no_permissions: bool = False
+    no_filesize: bool = False
+    no_time: bool = False
+    time_kind: str = "modified"
+    time_style: str = "default"
+    bytes_size: bool = False
+    binary: bool = False
+    ignore_globs: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    display_name: str
+    is_arg: bool = False
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self.path.name or self.display_name
+
+
+class EzaError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, code: int = 3) -> None:
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.code = code
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
+    try:
+        opts = parse_args(argv)
+        return run(opts)
+    except EzaError as exc:
+        sys.stderr.write(str(exc) + "\n")
+        return exc.code
+    except BrokenPipeError:
+        return 0
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Options:
+    opts = Options()
+    i = 0
+    stop = False
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if stop or not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":
+            opts.paths.append(arg)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            stop = True
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            name, value = split_long(arg)
+            i = handle_long(opts, name, value, argv, i)
+            continue
+        i = handle_short_cluster(opts, arg[1:], argv, i)
+    return opts
+
+
+def split_long(arg: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
+    body = arg[2:]
+    if "=" in body:
+        name, value = body.split("=", 1)
+        return name, value
+    return body, None
+
+
+def need_value(flag: str, value: str | None, argv: list[str], i: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
+    if value is not None:
+        return value, i + 1
+    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
+        raise EzaError(f"Option {flag} needs a value")
+    return argv[i + 1], i + 2
+
+
+def handle_long(opts: Options, name: str, value: str | None, argv: list[str], i: int) -> int:
+    aliases = {"colour": "color", "almost-all": "almost-all"}
+    name = aliases.get(name, name)
+    if name == "help":
+        sys.stdout.write(help_text())
+        raise SystemExit(0)
+    if name == "version":
+        sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT)
+        raise SystemExit(0)
+    if name in {"color", "color-scale", "color-scale-mode", "icons"}:
+        return consume_optional_or_required(name, value, argv, i)
+    if name in {"oneline", "long", "grid", "across", "recurse", "tree"}:
+        set_mode(opts, name)
+        return i + 1
+    if name == "all":
+        opts.all_count += 1
+    elif name == "almost-all":
+        opts.almost_all = True
+    elif name in {"treat-dirs-as-files", "list-dirs"}:
+        opts.dirs_as_files = True
+    elif name == "only-dirs":
+        opts.only_dirs = True
+    elif name == "only-files":
+        opts.only_files = True
+    elif name == "no-symlinks":
+        opts.no_symlinks = True
+    elif name == "show-symlinks":
+        opts.show_symlinks = True
+    elif name == "reverse":
+        opts.reverse = True
+    elif name == "group-directories-first":
+        opts.dirs_first, opts.dirs_last = True, False
+    elif name == "group-directories-last":
+        opts.dirs_last, opts.dirs_first = True, False
+    elif name == "sort":
+        opts.sort, ni = need_value("--sort", value, argv, i)
+        return finish_sort(opts, ni)
+    elif name == "level":
+        raw, ni = need_value("--level", value, argv, i)
+        opts.level = parse_positive_int(raw, "--level")
+        return ni
+    elif name == "width":
+        raw, ni = need_value("--width", value, argv, i)
+        opts.width = parse_positive_int(raw, "--width")
+        return ni
+    elif name == "ignore-glob":
+        raw, ni = need_value("--ignore-glob", value, argv, i)
+        opts.ignore_globs.extend([p for p in raw.split("|") if p])
+        return ni
+    elif name == "classify":
+        opts.classify = value if value is not None else "auto"
+    elif name == "absolute":
+        opts.absolute = value if value is not None else "on"
+    elif name == "no-quotes":
+        opts.no_quotes = True
+    elif name == "header":
+        opts.header = True
+    elif name == "no-permissions":
+        opts.no_permissions = True
+    elif name == "no-filesize":
+        opts.no_filesize = True
+    elif name == "no-time":
+        opts.no_time = True
+    elif name == "bytes":
+        opts.bytes_size = True
+    elif name == "binary":
+        opts.binary = True
+    elif name == "time":
+        opts.time_kind, ni = need_value("--time", value, argv, i)
+        return ni
+    elif name == "time-style":
+        opts.time_style, ni = need_value("--time-style", value, argv, i)
+        return ni
+    elif name in {"dereference", "follow-symlinks", "git", "no-git", "git-ignore", "hyperlink", "smart-group", "group", "numeric", "inode", "links", "modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "blocksize", "total-size", "mounts", "extended", "octal-permissions", "context", "flags"}:
+        pass
+    else:
+        raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument {('--' + name)!r}.")
+    return i + 1
+
+
+def consume_optional_or_required(name: str, value: str | None, argv: list[str], i: int) -> int:
+    if name in {"color-scale-mode"} and value is None:
+        return min(i + 2, len(argv))
+    return i + 1
+
+
+def handle_short_cluster(opts: Options, cluster: str, argv: list[str], i: int) -> int:
+    j = 0
+    while j < len(cluster):
+        ch = cluster[j]
+        if ch in "?v":
+            sys.stdout.write(help_text() if ch == "?" else VERSION_TEXT)
+            raise SystemExit(0)
+        if ch in "1lGxRT":
+            set_mode(opts, {"1": "oneline", "l": "long", "G": "grid", "x": "across", "R": "recurse", "T": "tree"}[ch])
+        elif ch == "a":
+            opts.all_count += 1
+        elif ch == "A":
+            opts.almost_all = True
+        elif ch == "d":
+            opts.dirs_as_files = True
+        elif ch == "D":
+            opts.only_dirs = True
+        elif ch == "f":
+            opts.only_files = True
+        elif ch == "r":
+            opts.reverse = True
+        elif ch in "LsIwFt":
+            raw = cluster[j + 1 :] or (argv[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(argv) else None)
+            if raw is None:
+                raise EzaError(f"Option -{ch} needs a value")
+            if ch == "L":
+                opts.level = parse_positive_int(raw, "-L")
+            elif ch == "s":
+                opts.sort = raw
+                finish_sort(opts, i + 1)
+            elif ch == "I":
+                opts.ignore_globs.extend([p for p in raw.split("|") if p])
+            elif ch == "w":
+                opts.width = parse_positive_int(raw, "-w")
+            elif ch == "F":
+                opts.classify = raw or "auto"
+            elif ch == "t":
+                opts.time_kind = raw
+            return i + (1 if cluster[j + 1 :] else 2)
+        elif ch == "h":
+            opts.header = True
+        elif ch == "B":
+            opts.bytes_size = True
+        elif ch == "b":
+            opts.binary = True
+        elif ch in "ginHmuUSMX@oZO":
+            pass
+        else:
+            raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument '-{ch}'.")
+        j += 1
+    return i + 1
+
+
+def set_mode(opts: Options, name: str) -> None:
+    if name == "long":
+        opts.long = True
+        opts.mode = "long"
+    elif name == "tree":
+        opts.mode = "tree"
+    elif name == "recurse":
+        opts.mode = "recurse"
+    elif name == "grid":
+        opts.mode = "grid"
+    elif name == "across":
+        opts.mode = "grid"
+    elif name == "oneline":
+        opts.mode = "lines"
+
+
+def finish_sort(opts: Options, ni: int) -> int:
+    aliases = {"newest": "modified", "oldest": "oldest", "size": "size", "name": "name", "Name": "Name", "extension": "extension", "Extension": "Extension", "type": "type", "none": "none", "created": "created", "changed": "changed", "accessed": "accessed", "modified": "modified"}
+    if opts.sort not in aliases:
+        raise EzaError(f"Bad argument for --sort: {opts.sort}")
+    opts.sort = aliases[opts.sort]
+    return ni
+
+
+def parse_positive_int(raw: str, flag: str) -> int:
+    try:
+        value = int(raw)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise EzaError(f"Invalid number for {flag}: {raw}") from exc
+    if value < 0:
+        raise EzaError(f"Invalid number for {flag}: {raw}")
+    return value
+
+
+def run(opts: Options) -> int:
+    paths = opts.paths or ["."]
+    entries: list[Entry] = []
+    code = 0
+    for raw in paths:
+        path = Path(raw)
+        if not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink():
+            sys.stderr.write(f'"{raw}": {not_found_message()}\n')
+            code = 2
+            continue
+        entries.append(Entry(path, display_path(path), True))
+    if not entries:
+        return code
+    if opts.mode == "tree":
+        output_tree(entries, opts)
+    elif opts.mode == "recurse":
+        output_recurse(entries, opts)
+    else:
+        output_flat(entries, opts)
+    return code
+
+
+def not_found_message() -> str:
+    return "系统找不到指定的文件。 (os error 2)" if os.name == "nt" else "No such file or directory (os error 2)"
+
+
+def display_path(path: Path) -> str:
+    raw = str(path)
+    if os.name == "nt" and "/" in raw and "\\" not in raw:
+        parent, _, name = raw.rpartition("/")
+        return parent + "\\" + name if parent else raw
+    return raw
+
+
+def output_flat(entries: list[Entry], opts: Options) -> None:
+    listed = collect_top(entries, opts)
+    if opts.long:
+        write_long(listed, opts)
+    elif opts.mode == "grid":
+        write_grid([format_name(e, opts) for e in listed], opts.width)
+    else:
+        write_lines(format_name(e, opts) for e in listed)
+
+
+def collect_top(entries: list[Entry], opts: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    if len(entries) == 1 and entries[0].path.is_dir() and not opts.dirs_as_files:
+        return list_dir(entries[0].path, opts)
+    result: list[Entry] = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        if entry.path.is_dir() and not opts.dirs_as_files and len(entries) > 1:
+            result.extend(list_dir(entry.path, opts))
+        else:
+            result.append(entry)
+    return sort_entries(filter_entries(result, opts, is_recurse=False), opts)
+
+
+def list_dir(path: Path, opts: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    result: list[Entry] = []
+    if opts.all_count >= 2:
+        result.append(Entry(path / ".", "."))
+        result.append(Entry(path / "..", ".."))
+    try:
+        with os.scandir(path) as scan:
+            for de in scan:
+                result.append(Entry(Path(de.path), de.name))
+    except OSError as exc:
+        sys.stderr.write(f'"{path}": {exc}\n')
+    return sort_entries(filter_entries(result, opts, is_recurse=False), opts)
+
+
+def filter_entries(entries: list[Entry], opts: Options, is_recurse: bool) -> list[Entry]:
+    out = []
+    for e in entries:
+        name = e.display_name
+        if not show_hidden(name, opts):
+            continue
+        if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pat) for pat in opts.ignore_globs):
+            continue
+        is_dir = e.path.is_dir()
+        is_file = e.path.is_file()
+        is_link = e.path.is_symlink()
+        if opts.no_symlinks and is_link:
+            continue
+        if opts.only_dirs and not is_dir:
+            continue
+        if opts.only_files and not (is_recurse or is_file or (opts.show_symlinks and is_link and not is_dir)):
+            continue
+        out.append(e)
+    return out
+
+
+def show_hidden(name: str, opts: Options) -> bool:
+    if name in {".", ".."}:
+        return opts.all_count >= 2
+    if opts.all_count or opts.almost_all:
+        return True
+    return not name.startswith(".")
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries: list[Entry], opts: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    if opts.sort == "none":
+        ordered = list(entries)
+    else:
+        ordered = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: sort_key(e, opts))
+    if opts.reverse:
+        ordered.reverse()
+    if opts.dirs_first:
+        ordered = sorted(ordered, key=lambda e: 0 if e.path.is_dir() else 1)
+    if opts.dirs_last:
+        ordered = sorted(ordered, key=lambda e: 1 if e.path.is_dir() else 0)
+    return ordered
+
+
+def sort_key(e: Entry, opts: Options):
+    st = safe_stat(e.path)
+    name = e.display_name
+    if opts.sort == "Name":
+        return natural_key(strip_dot(name))
+    if opts.sort == "size":
+        return st.st_size if st else 0
+    if opts.sort in {"modified", "oldest"}:
+        val = st.st_mtime if st else 0
+        return -val if opts.sort == "modified" else val
+    if opts.sort == "created":
+        return st.st_ctime if st else 0
+    if opts.sort == "changed":
+        return st.st_ctime if st else 0
+    if opts.sort == "accessed":
+        return st.st_atime if st else 0
+    if opts.sort in {"extension", "Extension"}:
+        ext = Path(name).suffix[1:]
+        return (ext if opts.sort == "extension" else ext.lower(), natural_key(name))
+    if opts.sort == "type":
+        return (type_char(e.path), natural_key(name))
+    return natural_key(strip_dot(name).lower())
+
+
+def natural_key(s: str):
+    return [int(p) if p.isdigit() else p for p in re.split(r"(\d+)", s)]
+
+
+def strip_dot(s: str) -> str:
+    return s[1:] if s.startswith(".") else s
+
+
+def safe_stat(path: Path):
+    try:
+        return path.stat()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+
+
+def write_lines(names: Iterable[str]) -> None:
+    for name in names:
+        sys.stdout.write(name + "\n")
+
+
+def write_grid(names: list[str], width: int) -> None:
+    if not names:
+        return
+    max_len = max(len(n) for n in names)
+    colw = max_len + 2
+    cols = max(1, width // colw)
+    rows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols
+    for r in range(rows):
+        line = ""
+        for c in range(cols):
+            idx = c * rows + r
+            if idx >= len(names):
+                continue
+            cell = names[idx]
+            line += cell if c == cols - 1 or idx + rows >= len(names) else cell.ljust(colw)
+        sys.stdout.write(line.rstrip() + "\n")
+
+
+def write_long(entries: list[Entry], opts: Options) -> None:
+    rows = [long_cells(e, opts) for e in entries]
+    if opts.header:
+        headers = []
+        if not opts.no_permissions:
+            headers.append("Permissions")
+        if not opts.no_filesize:
+            headers.append("Size")
+        if not opts.no_time:
+            headers.append("Date Modified")
+        headers.append("Name")
+        sys.stdout.write(" ".join(headers) + "\n")
+    widths: list[int] = []
+    for cells, _ in rows:
+        for i, cell in enumerate(cells):
+            if i == len(widths):
+                widths.append(0)
+            widths[i] = max(widths[i], len(cell))
+    for cells, name in rows:
+        parts = []
+        for idx, cell in enumerate(cells):
+            if idx in filesize_indexes(opts):
+                parts.append(cell.rjust(widths[idx]))
+            else:
+                parts.append(cell.ljust(widths[idx]))
+        sys.stdout.write((" ".join(parts) + (" " if parts else "") + name).rstrip() + "\n")
+
+
+def filesize_indexes(opts: Options) -> set[int]:
+    idx = 0
+    result = set()
+    if not opts.no_permissions:
+        idx += 1
+    if not opts.no_filesize:
+        result.add(idx)
+    return result
+
+
+def long_cells(e: Entry, opts: Options) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    cells: list[str] = []
+    st = safe_stat(e.path)
+    if not opts.no_permissions:
+        cells.append(permission_string(e.path))
